name: tesla-fsd-finder-au
description: Tesla FSD Finder Australia - Find underpriced Teslas with Full Self-Driving

scripts.postinstall: (command -v pip >/dev/null 2>&1 && pip install -r requirements.txt) || echo '[postinstall] pip not available; skipping Python deps'
scripts.start: python3 -m pip install -q -r requirements.txt >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000}
scripts.dev: python3 -m pip install -q -r requirements.txt >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000}
scripts.preview: python3 -m pip install -q -r requirements.txt >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000}
scripts.build: python3 -c "import main; print('build ok: app imports cleanly')"
scripts.build:android: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../dist/TeslaFSDFinderAU-debug.apk
